title: Service space templates: Redesigned detail cards and creation screen
description:
Service Collection has refreshed the template detail cards and the service space creation screen to provide a more visual and outcome-focused experience. This update introduces a two-column layout that replaces text-heavy capability lists with template-specific content and visuals, helping you quickly identify the best template for your team's needs. Select Spaces from the top navigation bar.
	Select Create space.
